name: Delta Cloud
notes:
Delta.BG (AS8860) applies routing security best practices in line with MANRS
(Mutually Agreed Norms for Routing Security) and encourages all peers to do
the same — see https://manrs.org

What we ask of peers:
- Register your prefixes as route/route6 objects in an IRR mirrored by RADB.
- Publish your AS-SET in your PeeringDB record ("IRR as-set/route-set"),
  using the IRR-NAME::ASxxxx:AS-SET-NAME form.
- Create and maintain ROAs for all prefixes you originate.
- Keep your NOC contact current in PeeringDB and your RIR database.

We filter peer announcements against your published AS-SET and IRR objects,
and we reject RPKI-invalid routes. Announcements not covered by your published
data will not be accepted.
